title: FriendlySMP
description: FriendlySMP is a growing Minecraft network built on mutual respect, community-driven fun, and chill vibes for all ages
body:
FriendlySMP is a growing Minecraft network built on friendships & respect, community-driven fun, and chill vibes for all ages. Whether you're into classic semi-vanilla survival, One-Block fun, or a pure vanilla SMP — we’ve got a server just for you.

### All of these servers are compatible with both Java and Bedrock!
ip: mc.friendlysmp.com
port: 19132

or add PlayFSMP as a friend and join their world!

## Semi-Vanilla
Survival minecraft with several plugins to add to the experience. Homes, quests, chest shops, and more! No world resets!

## Vanilla
Pure vanilla minecraft experience. No excessive plugins or bloat. Resets every few months to keep things fresh!

## OneBlock
New gamemode! Create your dream island, build farms, and compete with others on leaderboards! You can play solo, or create a team!

## Modded
We also have a modded server running the homestead modpack! More info at https://modrinth.com/server/friendlysmp-modded

Join our Discord:
[discord.gg/friendlysmp](https://discord.gg/friendlysmp)
